title: Generic decline
means: Generic decline 4000 0000 0000 0002 card_declined generic_decline

title: Always authenticate
means: Always authenticate 4000 0027 6000 3184 This card requires authentication on all transactions, regardless of how the card is set up.

title: rule: a publishable key retrieves a payment with its client secret
means: client_secret string Required if you use a publishable key. The client secret of the PaymentIntent. We require it if you use a publishable key to retrieve the source.

title: a payment given its method waits for confirmation
means: After your customer provides payment information, the PaymentIntent enters the requires_confirmation status and is ready to confirm.

title: a payment authorized and captured separately waits for its capture
means: If you’re separately authorizing and capturing funds, your PaymentIntent can instead move to requires_capture.

title: rule: a payment that succeeded is not canceled
means: You can cancel a PaymentIntent before it reaches a processing or succeeded state.

title: rule: only an open session can be expired
means: A Checkout Session can be expired when it is in one of these statuses: open

title: rule: only a finalized invoice is voided
means: Mark a finalized invoice as void. This cannot be undone. Voiding an invoice is similar to deletion , however it only applies to finalized invoices and maintains a papertrail where the invoice can still be found.

title: rule: an invoice no longer a draft is not deleted
means: Attempts to delete invoices that are no longer in a draft state will fail; once an invoice has been finalized or if an invoice is for a subscription, it must be voided .

title: rule: only a draft is finalized
means: Stripe automatically finalizes drafts before sending and attempting payment on invoices. However, if you’d like to finalize a draft invoice manually, you can do so using this method.

title: Test account numbers: pm_usBankAccount_success
means: 000123456789 pm_usBankAccount_success 110000000 The payment succeeds.

title: Generic decline
means: Generic decline 4000 0000 0000 0002 card_declined generic_decline

title: Always authenticate
means: Always authenticate 4000 0027 6000 3184 This card requires authentication on all transactions, regardless of how the card is set up.

title: Test account numbers: pm_usBankAccount_success
means: 000123456789 pm_usBankAccount_success 110000000 The payment succeeds.

title: a setup given its method waits for confirmation
means: After your customer provides payment information, the SetupIntent enters the requires_confirmation status and is ready to confirm.

title: microdeposit verification
means: If the customer opts for microdeposit verification, Stripe automatically sends two small deposits to the provided bank account.

title: payment_intent_unexpected_state
means: payment_intent_unexpected_state The PaymentIntent’s state was incompatible with the operation you were trying to perform.

title: setup_intent_unexpected_state
means: setup_intent_unexpected_state The SetupIntent’s state was incompatible with the operation you were trying to perform.

title: rule: sending a draft finalizes it
means: To finalize a draft invoice, use the Dashboard, send it to the customer, or pay it.

title: rule: only an active or not-started schedule is released
means: A schedule can only be released if its status is not_started or active .

title: close_authorization false
means: close_authorization boolean Whether to close the authorization after capture. Defaults to true. Set to false to enable multi-capture flows.

title: To end a trial early
means: To end a trial early, make an update subscription API call, setting the trial_end value to a new timestamp, or now to end immediately

title: a trial period on an existing subscription
means: Trial periods are normally applied at the start of a subscription, but you can also use a trial period on an existing subscription to change the subscription’s billing period (cycle) .

title: rule: a canceled subscription is largely immutable
means: After it’s canceled, the subscription is largely immutable. You can still update its metadata and cancellation_details .

title: active: a product no longer for sale
means: active boolean Whether the product is available for purchase.

title: active: a product for sale again
means: active boolean Whether the product is available for purchase.

title: active: a price no longer for new purchases
means: active boolean Whether the price can be used for new purchases. Defaults to true .

title: active: a price for new purchases again
means: active boolean Whether the price can be used for new purchases. Defaults to true .

title: active: a configuration switched off
means: active boolean Whether the configuration is active and can be used to create portal sessions.

title: active: a configuration switched on again
means: active boolean Whether the configuration is active and can be used to create portal sessions.

title: Create a Custom connected account
means: The basic process to create and connect a Custom connected account is to call the account creation endpoint, setting type to custom and providing a country and the appropriate capabilities .

title: rule: a voided invoice cannot be undone
means: Mark a finalized invoice as void. This cannot be undone.

title: a bank transfer waits for its funds
means: The PaymentIntent stays in a requires_action status until funds arrive in the bank account.

title: rule: a product with prices is not deleted
means: Delete a product. Deleting a product is only possible if it has no prices associated with it.

title: rule: both capabilities are disabled while either is inactive
means: If a connected account has both card_payments and transfers , and the status of either one is inactive , then both capabilities are disabled.

title: rule: a payout the balance does not cover is refused
means: Your Stripe balance must cover the payout amount. If it doesn’t, you receive an “Insufficient Funds” error.

title: rule: a transfer from a charge succeeds before its funds are available
means: When you specify the associated charge as the transfer’s source_transaction , the transfer request automatically succeeds. However, we don’t execute the transfer until the funds from that charge are available in the platform account.

title: rule: a refund names one of the documented reasons
means: String indicating the reason for the refund. If set, possible values are duplicate , fraudulent , and requested_by_customer .

title: amount_off
means: amount_off integer A positive integer representing the amount to subtract from an invoice total (required if percent_off is not passed).

title: error_if_incomplete
means: error_if_incomplete If payment fails, return an HTTP 402 status code and don’t create the subscription.
